title: Shell Calculator
description: Perform a calculation in the interactive Python shell.
problemStatement:
Open your terminal and launch the Python interactive shell. Compute the following expression:

```
(25 * 4 + 10) / 2
```

Write down the result. Then, using the underscore `_`, multiply that result by 3 and note the new value.
hints: Remember, just type the expression and press Enter – no `print()` needed.
After the first calculation, `_` holds the result (e.g., 55.0). Then do `_ * 3`.
